description:
Sr Process Capacity Engineer, AMZL WW Process Engineering

The WW Process Capacity Engineer works cross-functionally and is responsible for a variety of topics related to mechanical capacity management in the Process Engineering domain. The role's scope spans across different planning horizons, from short to long term, and collaborates closely with stakeholders across multiple business functions: Operations, Engineering, Launch & Expansion, Design and Planning.
The WW Process Capacity Engineering team is seeking an accomplished, analytical, hands-on and customer obsessed Process Capacity Engineer to join the team. You will be responsible for 4 core functions: (1) Own capacity calculation, drive insights & optimization for all planning cycles (3-Year Plan, Operational Plans (OP1/OP2) and High-Volume Events planning). (2) Own operations clock design, maintenance and improvement for your respective region/country. (3) Support and validate launch and retrofit assessments. (4) Forecast demand and manage supply for Volume-Driven Equipment.
The role is inherently cross-functional. You will have an opportunity to work with program managers, process engineers and operations leaders to define, improve and optimize the mechanical capacity of our delivery stations across the WW network. To be successful in this role, you should be able to work in a dynamic environment, think big and be comfortable navigating complexity and ambiguity. This position requires deep customer focus, strong self-drive, and strong analytical skills. You will need to be detail-oriented without losing sight of the big picture and business goals. You should have strong communication skills, be comfortable in analyzing data to provide data-driven recommendations, and be able to partner with stakeholders to arrive at the best result for our customers.

This role is based in Sao Paulo and requires occasional travel.

Key job responsibilities

  1. Own the monthly and yearly cadence of mechanical capacity planning cycles for a particular country/region.
  2. Analyze and make design recommendations for stations’ mechanical capacity to meet customer demand.
  3. Own analysis of performance against plan/forecast to drive continuous improvement.
  4. Forecast demand and manage supply of Volume-Driven Equipment needs.
  5. Lead dedicated programs to benchmark speed and capacity opportunities in the region.
  6. Support reporting cycles for Process Engineering/Capacity as well as High Volume Events in partnership with Peak Captains and Ops leaders.
  7. Provide actionable insights from strong analysis of large amounts of data.
  8. Apply best practices from and share best practices with WW counterparts.

A day in the life

Your day could include engagement with all levels of the organization and multiple stakeholder groups to drive short, mid and long term decisions that have large-scale impact across the AMZL network. You will use our internal tools to produce capacity calculations and varying levels of granularity and generate insights for operational and strategic decision making. You will work independently but as part of a team with similar responsibilities for other regions/topics. Your scope will alternate between a single country and WW, depending on the topic at hand.

About the team

The AMZL WW Process Engineering team partners closely with AMZL Operations and support functions to identify, design and develop best-in-class process infrastructure and process layouts, and to deliver them as AMZL network standard infrastructure. To enable this, the team supports prioritization of regional and WW continuous improvement initiatives in addition to cross-regional benchmarking. Irrespective of home location, all team members work on a mix of regional and WW initiatives.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Bachelor’s degree;
  2. Experience in a similar role in an industrial, logistics, production/manufacturing environment;
  3. An expert in the use of Excel;
  4. Quantitative and qualitative analytical skills;
  5. High level of written and verbal communication skills in English.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Basic level programming of at least one programming language (R, Python, C, etc.);
  2. SQL level proficiency;
  3. Excellent Project Management skills;
  4. Advanced data analysis skills.

title: Pintor
description:
Join to apply for the Pintor role at Logic Engenharia e Construções Ltda

Descrição do Cargo:
O Pintor de Manutenção desempenha um papel importante na aplicação de pintura e acabamento em diversas superfícies, como paredes, estruturas metálicas, móveis e demais elementos presentes em ambientes internos e externos. Esse profissional possui habilidades técnicas para realizar trabalhos de pintura com qualidade, eficiência e precisão. Abaixo estão algumas das principais responsabilidades desse cargo:

Responsabilidades:

  • Preparação das Superfícies: Preparar as superfícies que serão pintadas, incluindo a limpeza, lixamento, remoção de resíduos e aplicação de fundo ou primer quando necessário. Verificar e corrigir imperfeições nas superfícies antes da pintura.
  • Preparação e Mistura de Tintas: Preparar as tintas e vernizes adequados para cada tipo de superfície, seguindo as especificações do trabalho e as instruções do fabricante. Realizar a mistura correta das tintas, ajustando a cor e a consistência conforme necessário.
  • Aplicação de Tintas: Utilizar técnicas adequadas para a aplicação de tintas, seja com pincel, rolo ou pistola de pintura. Garantir uma cobertura uniforme e um acabamento de qualidade, respeitando as instruções e especificações do trabalho.
  • Reparos e Retoques: Realizar reparos e retocar áreas danificadas ou desgastadas nas superfícies pintadas, assegurando um acabamento consistente e uniforme. Corrigir eventuais falhas e imperfeições na pintura.
  • Segurança e Medidas de Proteção: Seguir as normas de segurança relacionadas à manipulação e aplicação de tintas, utilizando os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) apropriados. Adotar medidas para proteger áreas adjacentes e minimizar qualquer risco durante o processo de pintura.
  • Limpeza e Manutenção de Equipamentos: Limpar e cuidar dos equipamentos de pintura, garantindo seu bom funcionamento e conservação. Armazenar corretamente as tintas, solventes e demais materiais utilizados na pintura.
  • Organização e Planejamento: Organizar e planejar as atividades de pintura, garantindo a execução adequada dos trabalhos dentro dos prazos estabelecidos. Coordenar com outros profissionais e equipes envolvidas na obra ou projeto, quando necessário.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia como pintor de manutenção ou em atividades similares de pintura.
  • Conhecimento das técnicas de preparação de superfícies, aplicação de tintas e retocamento.
  • Familiaridade com diferentes tipos de tintas, vernizes e produtos relacionados.
  • Habilidade no uso de ferramentas e equipamentos de pintura, como pincéis, rolos e pistolas de pintura.
  • Conhecimento das normas de segurança relacionadas à pintura e uso de EPIs.
  • Capacidade de interpretar instruções e seguir especificações técnicas.
  • Habilidade em trabalhar de forma autônoma e em equipe.
  • Capacidade de se adaptar a diferentes ambientes de trabalho e projetos variados.

Segunda á sabádo de 08h ás 16:20

Nosso foco é garantir que a tecnologia esteja sempre alinhada com as melhores práticas e tendências do mercado, diferenciando-nos estrategicamente dos concorrentes. Estamos comprometidos em melhorar continuamente nossos processos e produtos para fornecer um suporte técnico de excelência que aumente a competitividade da Minerva Foods.

As soluções desenvolvidas pela nossa equipe impactam diretamente o resultado da empresa, garantindo que as decisões estratégicas e operacionais sejam fundamentadas em sistemas confiáveis e inovadores. Mantemos um diálogo contínuo com a camada executiva e estamos engajados em promover mudanças que aperfeiçoem nossa cultura e processos internos. Através de nossa dedicação à excelência em desenvolvimento de software, direcionamos a Minerva Foods para um futuro tecnicamente avançado e operacionalmente eficiente.


Main responsibilities

  • Desenvolver soluções web fullstack com foco em entregas rápidas, sustentáveis e de alto valor para o negócio;
  • Utilizar ativamente ferramentas low-code/no-code para acelerar a criação de funcionalidades, integrações e automações, sempre que adequado;
  • Explorar e aplicar ferramentas baseadas em inteligência artificial para acelerar o desenvolvimento, testes, documentação e resolução de problemas;
  • Avaliar a melhor abordagem técnica para cada desafio: desenvolvimento tradicional, low-code ou uso de IA, buscando sempre a melhor relação custo-benefício e velocidade;
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento fullstack , com domínio de pelo menos uma stack moderna (ex: React + Node.js , Angular + .NET, Vue + Python, etc.);

title: Vendedor de Serviços
description:
A empresa

As pessoas estão no centro de tudo o que fazemos na TK Elevator: trabalhamos em equipe, nos preocupamos com a segurança dos outros e compartilhamos uma visão comum para manter o mundo em movimento. Esta é a sua oportunidade de ir mais longe e impactar o futuro da mobilidade urbana.

Responsabilidades

  1. Realizar captação e resgate de clientes porta a porta em edifícios residenciais, comerciais, shopping centers e administradores de condomínios, fazendo contatos via telefone através da carteira de cliente para agendamento de visitas, reuniões e vistorias.
  2. Fazer o planejamento de vendas mapeando as regiões de acordo com a carteira de clientes, criando um funil de vendas e identificando oportunidades e criação das propostas.
  3. Elaborar relatórios de previsão de vendas mensais e de análise de mercado, ambiente externo, comportamento do setor e ações adotadas pela concorrência.
  4. Realizar as negociações de contratos de manutenções através de vistoria realizada nos elevadores, oferecendo um contrato de acordo com as necessidades do cliente.
  5. Verificar nas vistorias necessidades de reparo e apresentar orçamento com a solução mais adequada, de modo a agregar valor para ambas as partes.
  6. Prestar atendimento ao cliente abrangendo todas as atividades do ciclo de vendas de serviços, elaborando e apresentando propostas com as margens e descontos estabelecidos pela empresa, buscando manter ativa a carteira de clientes e atingindo as metas e resultados.
  7. Receber, intermediar e propor soluções às reclamações dos clientes pertinentes aos negócios, como divergências em notas fiscais, boletos, atrasos no serviço e equipamentos com problemas, reportando ao Gerente sempre que necessário.
  8. Participar das reuniões com síndicos, conselhos e assembleias quando solicitado pelo cliente.
  9. Executar atividades que necessitem o domínio de técnicas, seguindo procedimentos operacionais.
  10. Sugerir melhorias nos processos de sua responsabilidade.

Requisitos

  1. Ensino Superior em Andamento.
  2. Compreender as características do negócio da empresa conforme sua atuação sobre diversos pontos de vista, como organização, produtos e serviços, posicionamento no mercado, imagem da marca, concorrentes, movimentos do mercado, acordos comerciais e parcerias.
  3. Conhecimento dos tipos de produtos e serviços que a empresa comercializa, independente da área de atuação e nível hierárquico, e suas características como requisitos de qualidade, relação custo/benefício e vantagem competitiva.
  4. Conhecer técnicas e métodos que garantam vendas conforme foco de atuação e segmento do cliente, além de acompanhar todo o processo para assegurar a satisfação do cliente, levando a novas compras e a um relacionamento duradouro.
  5. Capacidade de analisar eventos prováveis ou improváveis/tendências e incertezas relacionadas a concorrentes, serviços ou produtos substitutos, vantagens competitivas e comportamento de clientes para subsidiar a tomada de decisão comercial.
  6. CNH ativa e veículo próprio para trabalho.

O que oferecemos

  1. Assistência médica
  2. Assistência odontológica
  3. Comissões
  4. Participação nos lucros
  5. Previdência privada
  6. Programa de acompanhamento a gestantes
  7. Telenutrição
  8. Vale-refeição

Outras informações

A TK Elevator se orgulha de ser um local de trabalho que oferece oportunidades iguais. Estamos comprometidos com a igualdade de oportunidades de emprego, independentemente de raça, etnia, gênero, religião, orientação sexual, condição de deficiência ou idade.

title: Designer Gráfico - Pleno|  V4 Sepulvida & Co
description:
No time da V4 Company, o Design é muito mais do que aparência – ele impulsiona negócios. Procuramos um Designer que saiba criar com propósito, transformando dados e estratégias em experiências visuais incríveis.
Se você quer aplicar sua criatividade em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e performance, chegou a sua oportunidade!
Nosso jeito de trabalhar:

  • Transparência e atitude definem nossa rotina.
  • Colaboração é essencial – confiamos uns nos outros para alcançar resultados.
  • Nada de hierarquias engessadas: aqui você tem autonomia para decidir e agir.
Se esse desafio te empolga, queremos te conhecer!
O Designer Pleno terá uma atuação criativa e estratégica, com autonomia para lidar com desafios de média complexidade e contribuir para a criação de materiais gráficos, motions e edições de vídeo. Ele será responsável por adaptar peças para diferentes públicos, utilizar dados de performance para otimizar campanhas e gerar insights de design para os negócios dos clientes.
Principais responsabilidades:
  • Criar peças gráficas e animações mais sofisticadas, adaptadas a diferentes públicos e objetivos.
  • Utilizar ferramentas como Premiere, Figma, After Effects e CapCut para desenvolver e otimizar os criativos.
  • Realizar testes A/B e analisar dados de performance para melhorar as taxas de conversão.
  • Desenvolver e aplicar técnicas de motion design para aumentar o engajamento nas campanhas.
  • Explorar o uso de IA para acelerar a criação de criativos e melhorar a qualidade visual.
  • Contribuir com insights e soluções criativas, aplicando fundamentos de design e performance.
  • Aprimorar a Defesa Criativa, justificando escolhas de design com dados e estratégias.
Requisitos:
  • Domínio de ferramentas de design como Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere e After Effects.
  • Experiência em criar animações intermediárias e Landing Pages.
  • Capacidade de análise de dados de performance e otimização de criativos.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de UX/UI e design para performance.
  • Autonomia para desenvolver materiais para diferentes públicos e campanhas.
O que oferecemos:
  • Os benefícios serão informados pela recrutadora.
  • Acesso aos cursos da Staage.
  • Onhappy - benefício corporativo de viagens a lazer.
  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento profissional.
  • Desenvolvimento contínuo e aprendizado constante.
  • Gestão meritocrática;
  • Possibilidade de sociedade baseada no desempenho e alinhamento cultural com o negócio.

JOB DETAILS:
 Job Name- Certified Nursing Assistant

Job Type- Local Contract

Break/Meal- 30 minutes
Shift Details- Monday to Friday availability. Will work 5 days in a week.
Weekend Hours: EOW
Weekly Guaranteed Hours: 40/week
Overtime Hours- If needed by the Facility.
Contract duration- 5 week (s) of contract
Bonus- Will be a discussion with Agency Recruiter.
POSITION SUMMARY:

  • Under the direction of the Center Nurse Executive/Infection Preventionist/Designee, the Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA)/ LNA license nursing assistant delivers efficient and effective nursing care while achieving positive clinical outcomes and patient/family satisfaction.
  • He/she will function within the standards of practice as accorded by his/her Certification.
  • The CNA performs various patient care activities and related non-professional services essential to caring for personal needs and comfort of patients.
  • The Certified Nursing Assistant may also be responsible for specimen collection for POC testing, where scope of practice, as well as state and federal regulations permit.
RESPONSIBILITIES/ACCOUNTABILITIES:
  • Provides patient care in a manner conducive to safety and comfort. Patient care includes, is not limited to:
  • Assists patient with or performs Activities of Daily Living (ADL).
  • Obtains and records Vital Signs and weights per policy.
  • Assist patients with ambulation and transfers.
  • Positions patients in correct body alignment in and out of bed; Applies adaptive equipment as ordered.
  • Cares for personal belongings.
  • Assists physician and/or licensed nurse with treatments and procedures as
  • needed.
  • Makes both occupied and unoccupied beds.
  • Accompanies patients when transported outside the center for appointments as
  • requested.
  • Ensures patients are ready for scheduled rehab therapy and transports patients to rehab.
  • Notifies licensed nurse if patient identification is missing.
  • Participates in the care planning process and implements care according to care plan. Perform skin treatments, as permitted by state regulation.
  • Applies simple clean dressings, slings, stockings, and support bandages, under direction of the licensed nurse, as permitted by state regulation.
  • Feeds or assists patients with meals and provides additional nourishment and hydration per care plan.
  • Records patient's oral intake and output.
  • Uses Point Click Care (PCC - POC) according to the Clinical System Processes, if applicable.
  • Answers call light or bell promptly, delivers messages, cleans areas of spillage or accidents.
  • Maintain infection prevention and control precautions practices according to policy. Participates in orientation of new nursing assistants.
  • Reports changes in patient's condition, patient/family concerns or complaints to charge nurse and/or supervisor.
  • Collects and bags soiled linen and delivers to dirty linen area.
  • Obtains clean linens and supplies from supply areas, cleans utility rooms, kitchen areas and all other nursing areas, as assigned.
  • Cleans patient equipment as assigned.
  • Transfers patient's belongings and equipment as directed, and assists with postmortem
  • Care.
  • Assists with patient discharge as requested
  • Assists with the orientation of newly hired CNAs.
  • Promotes a culture of safety to ensure healthy practice and living environment.
  • Collaborates and coordinates with other departments to provide timely effective care consistent with individual's needs, choices and preferences.
  • Contributes to an environment that is respectful, team-oriented, and responsive to the concerns of staff, patients and families.
  • Participates in quality improvement activities as requested.
  • Maintains confidentiality and protects sensitive Protected Health Information (PHI) at all times.
  • Stays and works beyond scheduled shift if needed to meet state staffing requirements and/or needs of patients.
  • Performs other duties as requested.
SPECIFIC EDUCATIONAL/VOCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
  • Successful completion of a state approved certified nursing assistant program.
  • A minimum of a high school education or high school equivalency diploma is preferred. This position requires that the employee is able to read, write, speak and understand the spoken English language to ensure the safety and wellbeing of our patients and visitors at the work site when responding to their medical and physical needs.
  • Must provide verification of TST (tuberculin skin test) as required by state law and in accordance with Company policy.
  • TSTs will be administered at the work site if required.
  • Basic knowledge of computer uses or willingness to learn.
  • Must attend a minimum of 12 hours continuing education programs provided by the center in order to maintain certification.
  • Complies with applicable legal requirements, standards, policies and procedures including but not limited to those within the Compliance and Ethics Program, Standard/Code of Conduct, Federal False Claim Act and HIPAA.
  • Participates in required orientation and training programs.
  • Promptly reports concerns and suspected incidences of non-compliance to supervisor, Compliance Liaison or to the Compliance Officer via the Integrity Hotline.
  • Cooperates with monitoring and audit functions and investigations.
  • Participates, as requested, in quality assurance and process improvement activities.
CERTIFIED NURSING ASSISTANT SPECIMEN COLLECTOR (In States Where Permitted)
RESPONSIBILITIES/ACCOUNTABILITIES:
  • Collect nasal specimens for point-of-care testing, following established procedures and manufacturer's recommendations.
  • Maintain specimen integrity by following appropriate infection control practices. Utilize appropriate personal protective equipment (gloves, gown, respirator and face shield/eye protection) for specimen collection.
  • Successful fit testing and ability to wear respirator (e.g. N95/KN95)
  • Ensure appropriate labelling of specimens collected.
  • Complete required documentation timely and accurately.
  • Successful completion of Point-of-Care testing specimen collection education and training.
  • Successful completion of specimen collection competency
  • Report malfunction of specimen collection equipment or incidents occurring during specimen collection.
  • Successful completion of Point of Care testing specimen processing and analyzing of specimens with POC testing instrument, as permitted by state and federal regulations.
  • Must be able to utilize PPE appropriately, including respirator, gowns, gloves and eye protection.
CNA Selection Criteria/Qualification Considerations must have a minimum of one of below
Completed and/or in CNA Career Ladder Program
  • Experience as Lab tech
  • Currently enrolled in nursing school
  • Experience as designated IP for conducting IC walking rounds
  • CNA/licensed nurses recommendations for CNA
  • Med Tech (must be within scope)
  • Med Aide (must be within scope)
  • Must be fit tested and be able to wear N95/KN95

title: Grower Engagement Manager
description:
Come work alongside some of the most talented minds in the agtech industry. We are a team of innovators who are accelerating the digitization and sustainability of our planet’s food system. At Arable, you will have the unique opportunity to build something meaningful with an amazing group of people who care about each other and their work.

What we do:

At Arable, our goal is to connect all the world’s farms to help optimize the global food system. This is an ambitious goal, but the need has never been greater to rethink how we will feed an ever-growing population and reduce our impact on natural resources. We believe the heart of the solution is digitizing the analog world with high-fidelity data to help food producers optimize their operations. We hope the impact of our work will improve the lives of farmers everywhere and be a major contribution to securing the global food supply for decades to come.

A few examples of the work we’re doing today:

Helping farmers in India and Mozambique adapt to the effects of climate change on their farms with novel data-driven crop insurance

Giving produce growers in California the tools to optimize production and minimize waste

Helping irrigated farms in Nebraska manage water more efficiently and sustainably to protect our water supply

Location Requirement:

Must be based within commuting distance of Vicksburg, Jackson, or anywhere along the corridor north to Leland. Locals refer to this agriculturally rich region as The Delta.

As a full-time Grower Engagement Manager at Arable, you’ll play a vital, customer-facing role on our Customer Success team—working directly with growers and partners in Mississippi’s Delta region to support the adoption of Arable’s technology. You’ll be a trusted advisor, helping growers improve irrigation practices, crop production, and sustainability outcomes by leveraging real-time field data.This is a field-oriented, full-time permanent position that blends agricultural expertise with relationship-building. You’ll work in close proximity to the farms you support and be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven agtech company.


What You’ll Do:
  • Support and train growers on Arable's field intelligence tools
  • Be the on-the-ground expert for agriculture and irrigation practices in The Delta
  • Customize solutions based on each grower's needs and goals
  • Build long-term relationships with growers and stakeholders in the region
  • Stay current on agtech trends and local practices to provide informed support
  • Drive adoption, retention, and satisfaction across the customer base
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure growers’ voices shape product development
  • Conduct periodic check-ins and performance reviews with growers
  • Identify opportunities for expanded use of Arable technology
You’re a Great Fit If You Have:
  • Deep familiarity with agriculture in Mississippi’s Delta region
  • Experience in irrigation management, crop production, or agtech implementation
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to travel frequently within the region (25–40%)
  • A background in agronomy, agricultural engineering, or similar fields
  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in a relevant discipline
  • Problem-solving mindset and passion for helping growers succeed

What we offer:

At Arable, you will be joining a company of dedicated team players who bring together diverse expertise and a passion for building a more sustainable future. We are a fast-moving startup committed to providing a rewarding employee experience through the work we do, the team, compensation, and benefits, including:

Excellent medical, dental, vision, and a 401k program

Flexible PTO

A focus on community involvement and career development

Being a part of creating innovative new products that have a positive impact on the world

At Arable, we don't just accept difference—we celebrate and support it. Not only because it's the right thing to do but because we draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced, and how we think to make Arable thrive. Arable is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and is an affirmative-action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, protected veteran status, and any other characteristic protected under applicable State or Federal laws and regulations.

title: Global Head of Cloud Alliances
description:
Join to apply for the Global Head of Cloud Alliances role at Canonical

6 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Global Head of Cloud Alliances role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.
Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go-to-market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.
Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.
Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.
The role entails

  • Taking ownership of Canonical's global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide
  • Building strong, cross-functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution
  • Inspiring and guiding teams to achieve accelerated revenue growth with Cloud partners, continually refining and evolving strategies for success
  • Establishing and nurturing executive-level relationships with key partners, laying the foundation for long-term success and mutual growth
  • Steering our offering from concept to execution, aligning product management and marketing strategies while scaling success through our global sales organization
What we are looking for in you:
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Exceptional leadership and presentation skills, capable of energizing teams and stakeholders while delivering compelling data-driven narratives
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • An in-depth understanding of open source technologies, Ubuntu, and the competitive ecosystem, with an eye for identifying opportunities that others might miss.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, and proactive—take ownership, and deliver exceptional results
Nice to have
  • A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success
  • Solid experience in the Public Cloud sector, coupled with an understanding of the evolving landscape of technology and innovation.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.
*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.
THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Sr. Manager Product Designer Web in our Marketing Operations area in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The Sr. Manager Product Designer Web is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the efforts of a team of web designers to ensure high-quality, strategically aligned design outcomes. As a leader, this role is accountable for setting design priorities, distributing tasks based on the skills and expertise within the team, optimizing existing design systems and processes for scalability, and contributing directly to practical design tasks when necessary. The Sr. Manager Product Designer Web also collaborates with cross-functional teams to establish design strategies that enhance user experience across multiple digital channels, including web and mobile platforms.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Build design process, delivering high-quality product interfaces while also maintaining and evolving design systems to ensure scalability and consistency across platforms.
  • Provide direct supervision to the team, offering guidance and support for their performance and development while ensuring alignment with company objectives.
  • Build the team - recruit, hire, and train new team members to ensure the team is staffed to full capacity.
  • Lead, mentor, and coordinate the efforts of a team of designers by delegating tasks according to skill sets and project demands.
  • Participate in leadership discussions to interpret and apply business strategy to design efforts, optimizing designs across channels (web and mobile).
  • Oversee and enhance the component library, particularly for scalability and mobile adaptability, collaborating with the team on component documentation.
  • Engage in strategic prioritization meetings to align design efforts with overall business goals;
  • Ensure tasks in Figma are well-organized and documented for development handoff.
  • Facilitate regular syncs with development and other departments to refine workflows, maintain alignment on goals, and support cross-departmental understanding of design assets.
  • Continuously refine and optimize design processes to improve delivery quality and team efficiency.
  • Directly participate in design delivery when needed.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Computer Science or related disciplines.
  • Advanced skills in Figma.
  • Expertise in User Experience best practices, Design and Accessibility guidelines Comprehensive understanding of design for web, mobile, and responsive interfaces.
  • Strong background in user-centered design and an understanding customer journey mapping.
  • Previous hands-on experience in design roles, with a proven track record of delivering impactful design solutions.
  • Experience with design systems: creating, maintaining, and optimizing them for consistency and efficiency across multiple platforms and teams.
  • Experience working with metrics, analytics, and user feedback, using data-driven insights to refine design solutions and measure success.
  • Expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies for user insights.
  • Strong project management abilities to prioritize, organize, and delegate tasks within the design team effectively.
  • Fluent English is mandatory.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in design roles and Proficiency in English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. As the Software Engineering Manager for Ubuntu Gaming, your mission is to help make gaming on Ubuntu first-class. In this exciting time for Linux gaming, compatibility tools like Proton have matured, but a well-rounded gaming experience goes beyond compatibility. It entails maximising performance, robust and secure anti-cheat mechanisms, full device support, and ease of content creation, sharing and discovery. By collaborating with open-source projects and other partners, you'll contribute to not just Ubuntu but the wider Linux gaming ecosystem.

  • Collaborating with upstream projects like Proton and partners like Unity to enhance Ubuntu's gaming capabilities.
  • Working closely with other teams to ensure a cohesive and comprehensive Ubuntu experience.
  • Driving performance improvements across a wide range of hardware.
  • Engaging actively with the open source and gaming community to gather feedback and collaborate on improvements.

  • An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with upstream projects and partners.
  • Familiarity and experience with the Linux graphics stack spanning user-space components to low level kernel drivers.
  • Exceptional software project management skills, encompassing risk assessment and resource allocation.
  • Ability to balance technical leadership with effective team management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both internal and external interactions.
  • Robust planning skills, demonstrated by your capacity to manage multi-cycle improvements.
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • A passion for technology and gaming, driving you to work with intelligent, motivated colleagues.
  • Initiative in proactively identifying opportunities and solving challenges.

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

description:
Software Engineering Manager, Ubuntu Gaming

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager, Ubuntu Gaming role at Canonical

Software Engineering Manager, Ubuntu Gaming

1 month ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager, Ubuntu Gaming role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
As the Software Engineering Manager for Ubuntu Gaming, your mission is to help make gaming on Ubuntu first-class. In this exciting time for Linux gaming, compatibility tools like Proton have matured, but a well-rounded gaming experience goes beyond compatibility. It entails maximising performance, robust and secure anti-cheat mechanisms, full device support, and ease of content creation, sharing and discovery. By collaborating with open-source projects and other partners, you'll contribute to not just Ubuntu but the wider Linux gaming ecosystem.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas or EMEA region.
The role entails

  • Leading your team in optimising and expanding the Ubuntu gaming experience, focusing on the Steam Snap.
  • Managing project timelines, balancing feature improvements with deadlines.
  • Collaborating with stakeholders to align your team's work with other teams and company objectives.
  • Conducting keen-eyed code reviews, focusing on quality, performance, and modern design principles.
  • Collaborating with upstream projects like Proton and partners like Unity to enhance Ubuntu's gaming capabilities.
  • Working closely with other teams to ensure a cohesive and comprehensive Ubuntu experience.
  • Driving performance improvements across a wide range of hardware.
  • Engaging actively with the open source and gaming community to gather feedback and collaborate on improvements.
What we are looking for in you
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with upstream projects and partners.
  • Familiarity and experience with the Linux graphics stack spanning user-space components to low level kernel drivers.
  • Exceptional software project management skills, encompassing risk assessment and resource allocation.
  • Ability to balance technical leadership with effective team management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both internal and external interactions.
  • Robust planning skills, demonstrated by your capacity to manage multi-cycle improvements.
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • A passion for technology and gaming, driving you to work with intelligent, motivated colleagues.
  • Initiative in proactively identifying opportunities and solving challenges.
  • Curiosity, flexibility, and a strong sense of accountability.
  • A focus on soft skills, including passion, enterprise, and self-motivation.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
